name: failure-fires-via-match-true
note: the chat call fails, so on_error (match_true) trips the one rule as if it matched, routing to its target BigLLM instead of falling back to default_model

name: success-match-routes
note: a successful reply that picks BigLLM matches rule route-BigLLM normally (not via on_error), routing to BigLLM

name: success-miss-falls-open
note: the chat call succeeds and the router picks TinyLLM, so on_error (match_true) does not apply; it only acts when the call fails. The one rule checks BigLLM at min_score 1.0, so a TinyLLM pick scores 0 for BigLLM and the rule misses. With no rule for TinyLLM, routing falls back to default_model, DefaultLLM. Landing on DefaultLLM rather than the picked TinyLLM shows match_true fires the rule only on a failed call, not on a normal mismatch.
